records.original_test_intent: The rule's own end is the underlined tab's stop, so the painted span equals the source span.
records.historical_contract_basis: Round 60: the physical blank span is source geometry, never a glyph count.
records.source_geometry_evidence: rule span 154.80..232.80; section left margin PAGE_LEFT_PT
records.current_behavior: tab_stops == [84.0, 162.0] - an anchor stop appeared in addition to the leader stop
records.new_architecture_contract: A rule that is at or ahead of the cursor needs no anchor: the leader tab alone owns the span (one stop). An anchor may be added only when the rule is genuinely ahead of the cursor.
records.new_invariant: A blank whose start the cursor has already reached registers exactly one stop - its own end.
records.blocking_reason: same decision path as the two records above

records.original_test_intent: A source DRAWN rule renders as a visible native Word blank, while a plain empty source region acquires no invented rule.
records.historical_contract_basis: Round 5.6 / Round 46: a source-drawn rule must render as one continuous underlined Word run; that representation was chosen because an underscore tab leader paints separate glyphs.
records.source_fixture: ruled paragraph '供应商：' with a source line at y=97, plus a plain paragraph with no source line
records.source_geometry_evidence: SourceLine(bbox=(145, 97, 300, 97)) for the ruled paragraph only
records.old_expected_behavior: some paragraph contains an underlined U+2007 figure-space run (assertion at line 123)
records.current_behavior: the ruled blank is still delivered as an underlined native run of the source's width, but via the intrinsic spacer (a space plus w:spacing tracking) rather than figure spaces
records.current_artifact_evidence: tests/test_round46_form_layout.py:123 assert False; the document has no underscore, no NBSP, zero layout tables, and the underline inventory still shows the blank
records.new_architecture_contract: Blank width is a measured quantity: a figure-space count can only approximate an arbitrary source width, so the intrinsic spacer owns the blank where the count cannot hit it exactly.
records.new_invariant: A source-drawn rule is delivered as a visible underlined native Word blank whose rendered width equals the source rule's own span within tolerance; the specific glyph used to paint it is not the contract. A plain empty region still acquires no rule.
